reviews.comment: Dafre is an awesome professor! Honestly so sad I had to drop her course because it conflicted with another class I needed. She's great at facilitating in-class discussion, is very friendly, and explains assignment criteria really well. She's awesome and I would definitely take her in the future!
Easy A class. She basically gives you an A on every assignment as long as you follow the directions. Lengthy, heavy group project, and no exams. She is bad about getting grades back to you quickly.
EASY A. There's a lot of writing assignments but honestly she's so easy everyone gets an A if you turn in your work on time.i did the bare minimum and turned in assignments and still got an A.

Would not recommend taking her summer courses, teacher did not grade any important assignments until the last possible moment. So each paper was written blindly given the no feedback the students were given.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Ms.Dafre was an excellent instructor she gave clear feedback and was very lenient. I had her for an 8 am class and I did miss class a handful of times, but she understood that it was hard for us to get up and gave me the full attendance points. She always tried to make a personal connection with her students by asking about our week.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was about Muslim women's literature which I did not realize until the semester started. Professor Dafre made it more interesting than I expected. Course is graded on weekly assignments and participation as well as an end of semester paper. You are required to purchase 4 books throughout the semester but I would buy them all asap.
